title: What's new?
bodyHtml:
Knowledge Portal Network News

Learn about recent milestones, collaborations, and resources from the Knowledge Portal Network. Click any news card below to read more or visit the relevant resource.

Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal Funding Extended

The Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSKKP; mskkp.org) has received an additional four years of support from NIAMS. The portal focuses on advancing discovery, uncovering disease mechanisms, and helping identify therapeutic targets for musculoskeletal disease.

 

NIDDK Celebrates Its 75th Anniversary

NIDDK marks 75 years of research that has improved the lives of millions of people with diabetes and related conditions. A new review highlights how AMP T2D and AMP CMD have identified genes and pathways that inform diagnosis and treatment of common metabolic diseases.

Help Shape the Future of the MSKKP

Have you used the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal or are you a potential new user? Complete a brief survey to share your experience and priorities, and help guide how the MSKKP evolves over the next several years.

<style>
    /* Page layout */
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
                   "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      background-color: #f5f5f7;
      color: #111827;
    }

    .news-page {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem;
    }

    .news-page h1 {
    color: #185468 !important;
    font-family: 'Barlow Condensed';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1.5em;
    margin-bottom: 0px;
}

    .news-page-intro {
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      color: #4b5563;
    }

    /* Card grid */
    .news-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .news-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .news-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .news-page {
        padding: 1.5rem 0.75rem 2.5rem;
      }
    }

    /* Card */
    .news-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease;
    }

    .news-card:hover,
    .news-card:focus-visible {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
      outline: none;
    }

    .news-card-image {
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #e5e7eb;
    }

    .news-card-image img {
      width: 100%;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.2rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      height: 100%;
    }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
      color: #1C3557;
    }

    .news-card-description {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: #374151;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }
  </style>
